puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti. so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno anādiyitvā saṅghaṃ anādiyitvā codakaṃ s'āpattiko'va yena kāmaṃ pakkamati.

3968.meaning1: not seeing the danger; not understanding the peril
3968.commentary: (VINa) anādīnavadasso'ti yaṃ bhagavā idāni sikkhāpadaṃ paññapento ādīnavaṃ dassessati, taṃ apassanto anavajjasaññī hutvā. sace hi, ayaṃ idaṃ na karaṇīyan'ti vā mūlacchejjāya vā saṃvattatī'ti jāneyya, saddhāpabbajito kulaputto tatonidānaṃ jīvitakkhayaṃ pāpuṇanto'pi na kareyya. ettha pana ādīnavaṃ apassanto niddosasaññī ahosi. tena vuttaṃ, anādīnavadasso'ti.

3969.meaning1: not seeing the danger in; not seeing the disadvantage of
3969.commentary: (DNa) anādīnavadassāvī'ti-ādīnavamattam'pi na passati. (THa) anādīnavadassāvī'ti yo nīlapīt'ādi-bhedesu iṭṭh'āniṭṭhesu rūp'āyatanesu gacchantaṃ yathāruci pavattantaṃ cakkhu'ndriyaṃ anivārayaṃ, anivārayanto appaṭibāhanto tathāpavattiyaṃ ādīnavadassāvī na hoti ce, diṭṭhadhammikaṃ samparāyikañ'ca ādīnavaṃ dosaṃ na passati ce. gacchantaṃ nivāraye anissaraṇadassāvī'ti ca pāṭho. tattha yo diṭṭhe diṭṭhamattaṃ bhavissatī'ti (saṃ. ni. 4.95) vuttavidhinā diṭṭhamatte'y'eva ṭhatvā satisampajaññavasena rūp'āyatane pavattamāno tattha nissaraṇadassāvī nāma. vuttavipariyāyena anissaraṇadassāvī daṭṭhabbo.

examples.text: tattha katamā cha gehasitā upekkhā? cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā uppajjati upekkhā bālassa mūḷhassa mandassa puthujjanassa anodhijinassa avipākajinassa anādīnavadassāvino assutavato puthujjanassa.
tesaṃ gihī pasann'ākāraṃ karonti. te taṃ lābhaṃ gadhitā mucchitā ajjhopannā anādīnavadassāvino anissaraṇapaññā paribhuñjanti.

3970.meaning1: (of views) not holding on tightly; not clutching

examples.text: pare sandiṭṭhiparāmāsī ādhānaggāhī duppaṭinissaggī bhavissanti, mayam'ettha asandiṭṭhiparāmāsī anādhānaggāhī suppaṭinissaggī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.
puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu asandiṭṭhiparāmāsī hoti anādhānaggāhī suppaṭinissaggī. yam'p'āvuso, bhikkhu asandiṭṭhiparāmāsī hoti, anādhānaggāhī suppaṭinissaggī, ayam'pi dhammo sovacassakaraṇo.

3971.meaning1: without support; without a stand; with no holder
3971.meaning2: without support; without a stand or holder

examples.text: ayaṃ cittassa ādhāro. seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, kumbho anādhāro suppavattiyo hoti, sādhāro duppavattiyo hoti, evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, cittaṃ anādhāraṃ suppavattiyaṃ hoti, sādhāraṃ duppavattiyaṃ hotī'ti.
saṅghagato kho pana anānākathiko hoti atiracchānakathiko. sāmaṃ vā dhammaṃ bhāsati, paraṃ vā ajjhesati, ariyaṃ vā tuṇhībhāvaṃ n'ātimaññati.
sabbesu kāmesu yo vītarāgo, ākiñcaññaṃ nissito hitvā m'aññaṃ, saññāvimokkhe parame'dhimutto, tiṭṭheyya so anānuyāyī.
parassa ce dhammam'anānujānaṃ, bāl'omako hoti nihīnapañño, sabb'eva bālā sunihīnapaññā, sabb'ev'ime diṭṭhiparibbasānā.

3974.meaning1: not greedy; without desire; not following lustful impulse
3974.commentary: (NIDD1) phassaṃ imāhi tīhi pariññāhi parijānitvā. anānugiddho'ti. (SNPa) anānugiddho'ti kañci dhammaṃ taṇhāgedhena ananugijjhanto.

examples.text: ubhosu antesu vineyya chandaṃ, phassaṃ pariññāya anānugiddho, yadattagarahī tadakubbamāno, na lippatī diṭṭhasutesu dhīro.

3975.grammar: prp of na anujānāti, neg, trans (+acc)
3975.meaning1: not accepting; not allowing; not permitting; not agreeing (with)

examples.text: parassa ce dhammam'anānujānaṃ, bāl'omako hoti nihīnapañño, sabb'eva bālā sunihīnapaññā, sabb'ev'ime diṭṭhiparibbasānā.
yo attano sīlavatāni jantu, anānupuṭṭho'va paresa pāva, anariyadhammaṃ kusalā tam'āhu, yo ātumānaṃ sayam'eva pāva.

3978.meaning1: who does not go on; who does not continue; remaining
3978.commentary: (SNPa) tiṭṭhe nu so tattha anānuyāyī'ti so puggalo tattha ākiñcaññ'āyatanabrahmaloke avigacchamāno tiṭṭheyya nū'ti pucchati. (NIDD2) anānuyāyī'ti anānuyāyī aviccamāno avigacchamāno anantaradhāyamāno aparihāyamāno

examples.text: sabbesu kāmesu yo vītarāgo, ākiñcaññaṃ nissito hitvā m'aññaṃ, saññāvimokkhe parame'dhimutto, tiṭṭheyya so anānuyāyī.

3979.meaning1: not pleased (with); not drawn (to); not attracted to
3979.commentary: (SNa) anānuruddho aviruddho kenacī'ti kenaci saddhiṃ n'eva anuruddho na viruddho bhaveyya.

examples.text: phassena phuṭṭho na sukhena majje, dukkhena phuṭṭho'pi na sampavedhe, phassadvayaṃ sukhadukkhe upekkhe, anānuruddho aviruddha kenaci.

3980.synonym: akappiya, akalla, appaṭirūpa, appatirūpa, ayutta, asāruppa, nappatirūpa

examples.text: hīnaṃ kāyaṃ upapannā bhavanto, anānulomā bhavat'ūpapatti, duddiṭṭharūpaṃ vata addasāma, sahadhammike hīnakāy'ūpapanne.

3982.grammar: abs of na āpajjati, neg, trans (+acc)
3982.construction:
na > an + ā + pajja + itvā
na + āpajjitvā

3983.grammar: fem, abstr, from na āpajjati, neg

examples.text: anāpatti asañcicca, assatiyā, ajānantassa, gilānassa, āpadāsu, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
anāpatti asañcicca, assatiyā, ajānantassa, gilānassa, uddharitvā vā bhinditvā vā paṭiggahe vā nīharitvā vā chaḍḍeti, āpadāsu, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

3985.meaning1: infrequently committing offences; not full of transgressions
3985.meaning2: who is not full of offences; who is not in the habit of offending
3985.commentary: (MNa) āpattibahulo'ti sāpattikakālo'v'assa bahu, suddho nirāpattikakālo appo'ti attho.

examples.text: idha, bhaddāli, ekacco bhikkhu adhicc'āpattiko hoti anāpattibahulo.

3986.commentary: (ANa) āpattiyā anāpattisaññī'ti tesaññ'eva vatthūnaṃ anāpucchākaraṇe āpatti, tattha anāpattī'ti evaṃsaññī.

examples.text: dve'me, bhikkhave, bālā. katame dve? yo ca anāpattiyā āpattisaññī, yo ca āpattiyā anāpattisaññī. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve bālā'ti.

3988.meaning1: (of a monk) who has not committed; who has not fallen into (an offence)
3988.meaning2: (of a monk) who has not committed; who has not fallen into (an offence)

examples.text: tass'etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, anāpanno vā pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ na āpajjissati, āpanno vā pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ yathādhammaṃ paṭikarissati.
yāvatikā ca bhikkhū kammappattā saṅgh'uposath'ārahā cattāro vā tato vā atirekā pakatattā pārājikaṃ anāpannā saṅghena vā anukkhittā.

3990.commentary: (NIDD2) anāparan'ti tamhā paro añño dīpo n'atthi. atha kho so evaṃ dīpo aggo ca seṭṭho ca viseṭṭho ca pāmokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro cā'ti, etaṃ dīpaṃ anāparaṃ. (SNPa) anāparan'ti aparapaṭibhāgadīpavirahitaṃ, seṭṭhan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: akiñcanaṃ anādānaṃ, etaṃ dīpaṃ anāparaṃ, nibbānaṃ iti naṃ brūmi, jarāmaccuparikkhayaṃ.

3991.meaning1: outside the range; outside the domain; not within the sphere (of)

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, āraññako mago araññe pavane caramāno vissattho gacchati, vissattho tiṭṭhati, vissattho nisīdati, vissattho seyyaṃ kappeti. taṃ kissa hetu? anāpāthagato, bhikkhave, luddassa.

3992.grammar: prp of na āpucchati, neg, ditrans (+acc & +acc)
3992.meaning1: not asking permission; not taking leave; not informing (somebody about)
3992.commentary: (VIN 2.5.2.4) anāpucchaṃ vā gaccheyyā'ti bhikkhuṃ vā sāmaṇeraṃ vā ārāmikaṃ vā anāpucchā

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu saṅghikaṃ mañcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā bhisiṃ vā kocchaṃ vā ajjhokāse santharitvā vā santharāpetvā vā taṃ pakkamanto n'eva uddhareyya, na uddharāpeyya, anāpucchaṃ vā gaccheyya, pācittiyaṃ.

3993.grammar: abs of na āpucchati, neg, ditrans (+acc & +acc)
3993.meaning1: having not asked permission; having not informed (somebody about)
3993.construction:
na > an + ā + √pucch + tvā > pucchā
na + āpucchā
3993.notes: see SaDM 17 laddhā'ti labhitvā. laddhānā'ti labhitvāna. diṭṭhā'ti disvā

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu nimantito sabhatto samāno santaṃ bhikkhuṃ anāpucchā purebhattaṃ vā pacchābhattaṃ vā kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjeyya aññatra samayā, pācittiyaṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu santaṃ bhikkhuṃ anāpucchā vikāle gāmaṃ paviseyya aññatra tathārūpā accāyikā karaṇīyā, pācittiyaṃ.

3994.meaning1: rule about sitting down without asking permission

3996.meaning1: rule about leaving without asking permission

3997.meaning1: rule about making beds without permission

3999.meaning1: not asked for permission; not taken leave
